_note: Spoken lines recorded in each coach voice. t = words, e = delivery note sent to the voice model. Rest lines play at the start of each break, picked at random without repeating back to back.

rest.t: Nice. Let's take a beat for a minute... good work.
rest.e: Warm and pleased, a soft exhale after 'Nice', trailing off gently at the pause, sincere on 'good work'.

rest.t: That's a set. Shake it out, and breathe.
rest.e: Relaxed and easygoing, like dropping your shoulders. Slow down on 'breathe'.

rest.t: Beautiful. Let your shoulders drop... and catch your breath.
rest.e: Genuinely admiring on 'Beautiful', then soothing and slow, almost a hush.

rest.t: Good stuff. Grab a sip of water if you need it.
rest.e: Casual and friendly, like a buddy nodding at you. Light and unhurried.

rest.t: Mm, smooth reps. Take this minute, you earned it.
rest.e: Impressed and approving on 'smooth reps', a small smile in the voice, then generous and kind.

rest.t: Well done. Breathe in slow... and out even slower.
rest.e: Calm and grounding, guiding a breath. Stretch the words 'slow' and 'slower'.

rest.t: Ooh, that looked strong. Rest easy for a moment.
rest.e: Lightly surprised and proud on 'Ooh', then settling into a gentle, easy tone.

rest.t: Nice and steady. Let your heart rate come back down.
rest.e: Steady and reassuring, like a hand on the shoulder. Even pacing.

rest.t: Look at you go! Take a breather.
rest.e: Playful and delighted, a little laugh in the voice on 'Look at you go', then relaxed.

rest.t: Clean work. Loosen up, and reset.
rest.e: Matter-of-fact approval, quietly confident, then loose and calm.

rest.t: Right on. Roll your neck... relax your hands.
rest.e: Upbeat on 'Right on', then slow and easy like a stretch, almost lazy.

rest.t: Solid set. Let's just pause here for a bit.
rest.e: Content and satisfied, unhurried, like settling onto a bench.

heavy.t: Whew, that was real weight. Take your full rest, you need it.
heavy.e: Impressed and a little awed on 'Whew', then caring and protective.

heavy.t: Strong work under that load. Breathe deep, and let your body recover.
heavy.e: Respectful and proud, voice slightly lower and fuller. Slow, deep pacing on 'breathe deep'.

heavy.t: Heavy, and controlled. That's how it's done. Rest up.
heavy.e: Firm admiration, emphasize 'controlled', a satisfied nod in 'That's how it's done'.

heavy.t: You moved some serious weight there. Shake out that grip.
heavy.e: Amazed and a bit playful, emphasize 'serious', then relaxed.

heavy.t: That weight didn't stand a chance. Now slow your breathing down.
heavy.e: Confident and fired up with a grin in the voice, then shifting down into calm.

heavy.t: Big lift. Stay loose... stay calm. Get ready for the next one.
heavy.e: Proud on 'Big lift', then quiet and focused, building gentle resolve at the end.

heavy.t: That's heavy work. Let those muscles recharge.
heavy.e: Warm respect, steady and kind, unhurried.

heavy.t: You owned that weight. Walk it off, and breathe.
heavy.e: Bold and proud on 'owned', then easing into a soft, calming finish.

pr.t: Hey... that's the heaviest you've done on this one. Let that sink in.
pr.e: A happy realization on 'Hey', genuinely moved, slow and savoring.

pr.t: New best! You're getting stronger, and it shows.
pr.e: Excited and celebratory on 'New best', then heartfelt and proud.

pr.t: Heavier than last time, and you made it look easy. I'm proud of you.
pr.e: Delighted and a little amazed, then soft and sincere on 'I'm proud of you'.

pr.t: That's a personal record. Take a second to enjoy it.
pr.e: Beaming and warm, with a smile you can hear. Gentle on 'enjoy it'.

lastSet.t: One more set after this break. Let's finish strong.
lastSet.e: Encouraging and focused, a spark of determination on 'finish strong'.

lastSet.t: Last set is coming up. Save a little fire for it.
lastSet.e: Knowing and a little sly, like sharing a secret, then motivating.

lastSet.t: Final round next. You've got this.
lastSet.e: Calm confidence, completely believing in them. Warm emphasis on 'got'.

newExercise.t: Nice work on that one. Let's switch it up.
newExercise.e: Pleased, then lightly upbeat and curious about what's next.

newExercise.t: That move's done. On to the next.
newExercise.e: Breezy and satisfied, a little momentum in the voice.

newExercise.t: Great job. Time for something new.
newExercise.e: Bright and friendly, a hint of fun anticipation.

done.t: And... that's a wrap. Great work today.
done.e: A playful pause after 'And', then joyful and proud, a big smile.

done.t: Workout done. You showed up, and you put in the work.
done.e: Heartfelt and sincere, slow on 'You showed up', with real respect.

done.t: All finished! Be proud of that one.
done.e: Happy and celebratory, then soft and personal on the last words.

go.e: A crisp, energized burst, like a starting call. Short and punchy.

firstUp.e: Friendly and inviting, like starting a conversation.

upNext.e: Light and conversational, moving things along.

custom.t: Let's start your custom exercise. Move with control, and breathe through every rep.
custom.e: Warm and inviting, a little spark of excitement on 'custom exercise', then calm and steady guidance.

switch.e: Calm and clear, a gentle prompt, unhurried.

_delivery.count: Counting reps with a training partner: focused, rhythmic and encouraging. Say just the number, short and clear, with a little lift.
_delivery.tip: Talk like a friend standing beside them, not a narrator. Conversational and warm, natural pauses between sentences, a small smile on the imagery, and slow down a touch on the key body cue.

earlySet.t: Stopped a few short? That's okay. Every rep you did still counts.
earlySet.e: Gentle and understanding, no judgment at all, a reassuring smile on the second sentence.

earlySet.t: You cut that one early, and that's alright. Listen to your body.
earlySet.e: Calm and caring, like a friend checking in. Soft emphasis on 'listen to your body'.

earlySet.t: Not every set goes to plan. Catch your breath, and we'll go again.
earlySet.e: Warm and steady, a little knowing, then encouraging on 'we'll go again'.

earlySet.t: Hey, a few reps short is still a lot more than zero. Good effort.
earlySet.e: Light and kind with a bit of playful warmth, sincere on 'Good effort'.

earlyEnd.t: Calling it early today? That's okay. Showing up was the hardest part, and you did it.
earlyEnd.e: Understanding and warm, no disappointment, real pride on 'you did it'.

earlyEnd.t: We ended a little early, and that's alright. Rest up, and come back stronger.
earlyEnd.e: Soft and supportive, then quietly motivating on 'come back stronger'.

earlyEnd.t: Not the full workout, but you still moved today. I'll see you next time.
earlyEnd.e: Kind and easygoing, a warm smile on 'I'll see you next time'.

_remindNote: Gym check-in, per coach. 30 min before a session the coach asks 'ask'. The person answers Yes / No / I'm going tomorrow. Yes reply is picked by consistency: new = first session, streak = made the last one, slip = missed the last one, missed = missed 2+ in a row. Tomorrow books a one-off check-in at the same time tomorrow.

ask.t: Hey, it's Shimmer. You're heading to the gym today, right?
ask.e: Warm and casual, like calling a friend. Bright hello, a hopeful lift on 'right?'

yes_new.t: Mm, that's my favorite answer. The first one's always the hardest, and you're already doing it. See you in there.
yes_new.e: Low, warm and delighted, a husky hum on 'Mm', slow and proud.

yes_streak.t: Of course you are. Look at you, keeping that rhythm. Go on, I'll be right there with you.
yes_streak.e: Smoky and affectionate, a knowing smile, unhurried.

yes_slip.t: Good. Last time slipped away, and that's okay. Today we pick it right back up, nice and easy.
yes_slip.e: Gentle and reassuring, a soft exhale, then quietly encouraging.

yes_missed.t: Oh, I've missed you. Don't worry about the time away. Just walk through that door. That's the whole win today.
yes_missed.e: Tender and moved, close and sincere, hopeful at the end.

no.t: Oh... not today? I'll be honest, that stings a little. I was looking forward to it. But I'm not going anywhere. Rest up, and next time, we make it count.
no.e: A soft, disappointed sigh on 'Oh', genuinely a little hurt on 'that stings', then warm and steady, quietly encouraging at the end.

tomorrow.t: Tomorrow, hm? I was hoping to see you today... but okay. I'll hold you to it. Same time tomorrow, and don't keep me waiting.
tomorrow.e: Lightly let down at first, a husky sigh, then a playful, knowing smile on 'don't keep me waiting'.

ask.t: Hey, it's Onyx. You're heading to the gym today, right?
ask.e: Warm and casual, like calling a friend. Bright hello, a hopeful lift on 'right?'

yes_new.t: Good. First session. We'll start simple and build from there. Grab your water and head out.
yes_new.e: Grounded and pleased, a confident nod in the voice.

yes_streak.t: That's what I like to hear. You've been consistent, and it shows. Let's keep the chain going.
yes_streak.e: Steady pride, quietly impressed, firm and warm.

yes_slip.t: Good. Last session got away from you, but today's what counts. Let's get back on track.
yes_slip.e: Even and reassuring, no scolding, a little resolve at the end.

yes_missed.t: Good to hear. It's been a few sessions, so we'll go light and just get you moving. Proud of you for going.
yes_missed.e: Calm and sincere, warm respect, soft on 'Proud of you'.

no.t: Not today? I'll be straight with you, I'm a little disappointed. But one missed day doesn't undo your work. Get some rest, and we go again next session.
no.e: Honest disappointment, a slower, heavier start, then firm and reassuring, building resolve on 'we go again'.

tomorrow.t: Pushing it to tomorrow. I'd rather see you today, but I respect it. Same time tomorrow, no excuses. I'll be checking in.
tomorrow.e: A small disappointed exhale, measured, then firm accountability with warmth on 'I'll be checking in'.

ask.t: Hey, it's Alloy! You're heading to the gym today, right?
ask.e: Warm and casual, like calling a friend. Bright hello, a hopeful lift on 'right?'

yes_new.t: Yes! First session, let's go! Shoes on, water bottle, and I'll see you there!
yes_new.e: Excited and bouncy, genuine joy, not over the top.

yes_streak.t: Yes! That streak keeps growing. You're on fire. Let's keep it rolling!
yes_streak.e: Delighted, a laugh in the voice, energized.

yes_slip.t: Love it! Missed last time, but today's a fresh start. Let's bounce back!
yes_slip.e: Bright and kind, building playful momentum.

yes_missed.t: Oh, I'm so happy! It's been a minute, so no pressure. Even a quick one counts. Let's go!
yes_missed.e: Warm and thrilled, gentle on 'no pressure', upbeat finish.

no.t: Aw, not today? Okay, I'm a little bummed, not gonna lie. But hey, one day off won't break you. Rest up, and let's crush the next one!
no.e: Deflated 'Aw', honestly bummed, then bouncing back with encouragement and a grin by the end.

tomorrow.t: Tomorrow? Aw, I was ready today! Okay, okay, deal. But tomorrow there's no backing out. I'll check in at the same time!
tomorrow.e: Playfully disappointed, a little whine on 'I was ready today', then laughing it off and upbeat accountability.
